title: Libreville suburban taxi drivers’ vehicle stoppage over municipal levies and Transport Directorate

scope: Vehicle stoppage; extent beyond the named union and locations unknown
organizer: Syndicat libre des transporteurs terrestres du Gabon (Syltteg), represented by Jean-Robert Menier
threshold_50_evidence: No number of drivers, vehicles or attendees reported; parked vehicles do not establish a 50-person gathering.

occurrence.evidence: Source reports drivers parked their vehicles on 7 October to express discontent.

date.evidence: Report dated 7 October and says the stoppage began that Monday.

location.evidence: Libreville; exact group assembly site is not provided.

state_target.evidence: Drivers demanded action by the City Hall Transport Directorate and removal of its leadership; local municipal authority is the stated target.

notes: The state/local-authority demand is explicit, but the article establishes a vehicle stoppage rather than a qualifying public gathering or turnout. Do not treat drivers’ workforce as attendees.
